<DOCSTRING>
Creates a state space tree to iterate through each branch using DFS.
It terminates the branching of a node when the sum of the current path exceeds the maximum sum or when the remaining numbers sum plus the current path sum is less than the maximum sum.
This algorithm follows depth-first search and backtracks when the node is not branchable.

Args:
    nums (list[int]): The list of numbers to generate the state space tree.
    max_sum (int): The maximum sum allowed for any path in the tree.
    num_index (int): The current index in the nums list.
    path (list[int]): The current path in the state space tree.
    result (list[list[int]]): The list to store all valid paths.
    remaining_nums_sum (int): The sum of the remaining numbers in nums.

Returns:
    None: This function modifies the result list in place.
</DOCSTRING>
